existing_sdc.basis: constraints/timing.sdc:1 create_clock [get_ports i_clk] -period 2；端口 i_clk 与顶层 aes128_core 的时钟输入端口名一致 (rtl/aes128_core.v:28)，适用

ports.name: i_clk
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:28，下游时序块以 posedge i_clk 采样 (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:84, rtl/aes128_dpc.v:64,140)

ports.name: i_rst
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:29，传入 keyex/dpc 作复位 (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:84, rtl/aes128_dpc.v:64)

ports.name: i_flag
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:30 加解密选择控制，参与数据路径与状态机 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:76,113-118)

ports.name: i_key
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:31，初始密钥输入，时钟载入 r_key (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:74,84-89)

ports.name: o_key_ok
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:33，密钥扩展完成标志，寄存器输出 (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:112-121)

ports.name: i_din
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:34，明文/密文数据输入，经 r_din 时序采样 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:106,140-147)

ports.name: o_dout
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:36，数据输出，由 i_clk 域寄存器/组合逻辑驱动 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:149)

ports.name: o_dout_en
ports.basis: rtl/aes128_core.v:37，输出有效指示，寄存器 r_count 生成 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:151)

clocks.name: i_clk
clocks.basis: 顶层唯一时钟输入 rtl/aes128_core.v:28；全部时序块为 posedge i_clk (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:84,91,99,112; rtl/aes128_dpc.v:64,140)；SDC 亦在该端口定义时钟 (constraints/timing.sdc:1)

resets.basis: always@(posedge i_clk or posedge i_rst) 且 if(i_rst) 复位，异步高有效 (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:84-97,99-119; rtl/aes128_dpc.v:64-73,140-147)

io_clock_associations.basis: 参与 posedge i_clk 时序逻辑与同域组合逻辑 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:76-103,143-146)
i_key_en 有效时在 posedge i_clk 载入 r_key (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:74,84-89)
在 posedge i_clk 域被采样用于状态计数与标志 (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:99-119)
寄存器 r_key_ok 在 posedge i_clk 更新 (rtl/aes128_keyex.v:112-121)
s_din 选择 i_din 后由 posedge i_clk 写入 r_din (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:106,140-147)
在 posedge i_clk 域被采样 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:67,106)
o_dout = i_sbox_dout^r_ka，r_ka 为 i_clk 域组合/时序逻辑生成 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:75-103,149)
由 i_clk 域计数寄存器 r_count 译码 (rtl/aes128_dpc.v:64-73,151)

unresolved: rtl/aes128_dpc.v:66,68,70,72,142,144,146 与 rtl/aes128_keyex.v:86,88,93,95,101,103,105,107,114,116,118 存在行内赋值延迟 #DLY (localparam DLY=1, rtl/aes128_dpc.v:40 / rtl/aes128_keyex.v:39)；综合通常忽略该延迟，但对其处理方式依赖工具流程，是否需在约束/网表阶段剔除未能确定
constraints/timing.sdc:1 周期 2 未标注时间单位且无 set_units，单位默认值（通常 ns）依赖工具设定
